function.arguments: {"observation": "`patient_id` has 48 duplicate values — rows may not be one-per-entity. There are 848 rows and 800 unique `patient_id`s. This means 48 patients appear more than once.", "implication": "The trial data includes re-tested patients who appear in multiple rows. According to the data dictionary, a patient who was re-tested appears twice, and the row with the highest `sample_seq` supersedes earlier rows. Therefore, we must deduplicate on `patient_id`, keeping the row with the highest `sample_seq` per patient, before computing response rates. Failure to do so would double-count or over-weight re-tested patients, biasing the response rate."}
function.name: note_finding
